title: Stiff: The Curious Lives of Human Cadavers
author: Mary Roach
summary: Mary Roach explores what happens to human bodies after death, from medical dissection and crash tests to composting and forensic study, with dry humor.
readIf: you are curious about death and science and enjoy witty, respectful nonfiction.
skipIf: you are squeamish about bodies or the detail of how they are used.
